digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and provenance tracking across plan-review, completion, and code-review gates
propositions: Signed gate verdicts record only a model string and cannot distinguish between first-class providers (Bedrock, Anthropic) and best-effort tiers (custom base_url/Ollama), making it impossible for consumers to validate which provider actually served a verdict.

A new additive-only provider_provenance field must be stamped into verdicts to record provider, endpoint_host, tier, and the complete effective capabilities record from the run, without breaking backward compatibility or requiring store migrations.

The provenance record must be assembled once in runner.py from data already held in scope (resolved model, provider name, base_url, capabilities), reusing the capabilities record computed during the run and never recomputing it to prevent divergence.
Credential material from base_url (user:secret@host) must never appear in the persisted sidecar payload; endpoint_host must extract only the hostname via urlparse().hostname, never netloc.

The plan-review, completion, and code-review gate verdicts must all carry provider_provenance from their respective runner step outputs through the coach/reconcile workflow operations into sidecar build_payload, requiring wiring through workflow YAML and Python call sites but no changes to providers.py.
